Leah Tran: Scheduling note for candidate (Aisha Khan) visiting Thurs. She asked if we can arrange airport pickup (arrives 08:20) and a signer for part of the loop. Anyone able to coordinate?
Marco Ruiz: I can do airport pickup if needed. Happy to meet at arrivals and bring a badge.
Sam (People Ops): Thanks Marco. Leah, can you confirm which signer type? ASL interpreter? We'll also need to book a quiet room with captioning if possible.
Leah Tran: Yes ASL interpreter for 10:00-12:00 session. Also requested a hotel for the night after because flight home is early next day.
Accessibility Team: We have an on-call ASL interpreter partner. Available windows show: 09:45-12:15 and 13:30-15:00. Booking now. :calendar:
FrontDesk Bot: Parking request received. Please confirm vehicle make/model to print permit.
Marco Ruiz: Car is Toyota Camry, plate ABC-1234. Will leave permit at reception if printed.
Sam (People Ops): Noted. Also candidate asked for a Mac, but they use Linux mainly. IT, can we prep a loaner with Docker + pre-cloned repos and a local user with limited internet?
IT Desk: Checking loaner inventory...
```
loaners.get_available(os="linux-friendly", date="2024-07-04") => [LN-33 (ThinkPad w/ Ubuntu), LN-40 (Dell w/Pop_OS)]
```
IT Desk: LN-33 available. We can image with Docker and create a temporary user that expires in 12 hours. We can also disable outbound traffic if you want a locked environment.
Leah Tran: Yes please lock outbound. Also need VPN for a quick private repo pull during the loop. Can you pre-stage the clone on the loaner?
IT Desk: Will preload repo and disable network egress. VPN not needed if repo is staged. Confirm repo name and branch via DM.
Sam (People Ops): I'll DM details. Also booking hotel: we offer overnight for candidates flying >3 hours; this one qualifies. I'll reserve a nearby hotel and send confirmation.
Accessibility Team: ASL interpreter booked (Agency: ClearSign) for 09:45-12:15. We'll email interpreter instructions and request arrival at 09:30.
FrontDesk Bot: Visitor check-in script updated: "Ask for ID, hand ASL badge ribbon, parking pass Lot D, direct to Meeting Floor 6. Reception to call Marco on arrival"
Leah Tran: Great. One more: candidate requested a lunchtime salad (no nuts). I'll mark dietary.
Marco Ruiz: I'll meet them at arrivals and bring a printed agenda + hotel voucher. Ping me if pickup time changes.
Sam (People Ops): Checklist: airport pickup confirmed, hotel reserved, ASL interpreter booked, loaner reserved and staged, parking pass requested, dietary noted. I'll post the final packet to candidate email tonight. :white_check_mark:
IT Desk: Loaner LN-33 reserved and imaged. Pre-staged repo present. Network egress disabled.
FrontDesk Bot: All visitor materials (badge, ribbon, parking pass, hotel voucher) printed and staged at reception.
Leah Tran: Thanks team. I'll loop back tomorrow with final ETA and keep this thread updated if anything changes. :thumbsup:
